articles.title: Whistleblower Sues Elon Musk's xAI, Claiming He Was Fired After Raising Grok Safety Concerns
articles.snippet: Devin Kim alleged he was terminated after repeatedly warning about bias, misinformation, and dangerous outputs from Elon Musk's Grok chatbot.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO Warns AI Is Getting Too Powerful—While Releasing Powerful AI
articles.snippet: In a new essay, Dario Amodei called for binding safety rules for frontier models as his company heads toward an IPO.
